responsibility: Declares the Rust typechecker’s adjustment and autoderef framework. It defines the Adjustment record that describes implicit receiver transformations such as autoref, deref, overloaded deref, indirection, and unsize; the Adjuster helper that materializes resulting TyTy types from such steps; and the AutoderefCycle base class that drives repeated autoderef/autoref search for clients like coercion and dot-operator method resolution.
same_name_distinction: Declares the shared autoderef types and interfaces—Adjustment, Adjuster, and the AutoderefCycle base class—that other typecheck components use. Unlike rust-autoderef.cc, it does not perform deref search or lang-item/operator-overload resolution; it only defines the framework those implementations rely on.
